title: Employee contact list
statementMd:
List every employee's first name, last name and email address.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Name the three columns you want after `SELECT`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM employees;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.

expected.query: SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM employees;
